Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Although foils and non-foils share the equinox equally, some are more enticed by the allure of non-foils. This bundle was made for them and includes only the enigmatic non-foils that draw us in with their tempting allure.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: Vault Boy
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: Points of Interest
• 1x Secret Lair x Fallout®: S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
• 1x Featuring: Phoebe Wahl
• 1x Diabolical Dioramas
• 1x Artist Series: Rovina Cai
